sections.Profile:
"Swing Time" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation on May 20, 1963. Designed by Steve Kordek, the game features a dancing and music theme, capturing the lively spirit of the early 1960s. The playfield includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, three rollover buttons, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Good Times, Dancing, Original Theme, Music, Single level playfield
